column1: # agent-notepad price table, used by `scripts/collab.sh cost`.
# USD per 1M tokens.  model  input  output  cache_read  cache_write_5m  cache_write_1h
# A trailing * matches every model that starts with the text before it. Exact names win over prefixes.
# Models not listed here show "n/a" instead of a cost. Prices change: re-check the vendor page and edit.
claude-haiku-5-5    0.10   0.50   0.01    0.125   0.20    # prompts up to 100K tokens; longer prompts cost 5x
# Short-context prices (prompt up to 272K tokens; longer prompts cost about 2x). Cache writes go in the 5m column.
# agy model names carry an effort suffix (gemini-3.8-flash-high); `cost` strips it to find the price.
# Gemini bills context-cache storage per hour, not per write; that isn't in the logs, so it isn't counted.
gemini-3.1-pro*     2      12     0.20    0       0       # prompts up to 200K; longer prompts: 4 18 0.40
# gemini-3.7-flash is offered in agy but has no public API price: it shows n/a.
